basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old living in Austin, Texas. By day, I'm a software developer working on mobile apps, and by night, I'm diving deep into the world of home theater systems. I've recently moved into my own apartment and am eager to set up the perfect entertainment space. I'm single, and my evenings often involve experimenting with different sound setups or catching up on the latest 'Survivor' episodes. I usually browse Reddit during my lunch breaks and late at night, around 10 PM to midnight.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise lies primarily in software development, stemming from a Computer Science degree and five years in the tech industry. I've recently taken an interest in home theater systems, learning through online forums and YouTube tutorials.
